title: Gimbal object wobbles after video cuts out

tellings.quote: according to the air crew, it wobbles after the video cuts out, right?

plain: In the Gimbal video, a 2015 Navy infrared clip filmed off Florida showing an object that appears to rotate, the object is said to keep wobbling after the recording stops. The commentator Marik von Rennenkampff says this is according to the air crew, citing the Navy fighter pilot Ryan Graves. He brings it up because it would mean the object's motion was real and not just something the camera did.
